title: Tetrandrine enhances anti-PD-1 immunotherapeutic efficacy for hepatocellular carcinoma by activating STING/TBK1/IRF3 pathway.
authors: Zheng, Biao; Yao, Guojun; Pang, Yuli; Luo, Jielong; Yang, Zhiyong; Xiu, Fengmin; Zhen, Chaohui; Liang, Rui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子药物TET通过STING通路增强抗PD-1免疫治疗肝癌，仅用分子对接预测药物与蛋白互作，核心非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) remains a significant global public health risk, and its mortality rate remains high. Tetrandrine (TET) inhibits tumor growth, but its combination with anti-PD-1 immunotherapy has not been fully elucidated. METHODS: STING was knocked down in HCC cells, and CD8(+) T cells were extracted and activated from peripheral blood. CD8(+) T cells were co-cultured with HCC cells, and TET was added. This study evaluated TET's effects on HCC malignant behavior and CD8(+) T cell activation in the co-culture system. gamma-H2AX and dsDNA were detected through immunofluorescence and Western blot. The interaction between TET and the proteins of STING/TBK1/IRF3 pathway was predicted by molecular docking, and the activation of this pathway was analyzed by Western blot. Subcutaneous and orthotopic HCC models were established in mice. The therapeutic effects of TET+anti-PD-1 were evaluated by tumor volume measurement, histopathological analysis and immunohistochemistry, and serum biochemical indicators were detected for safety evaluation. RESULTS: TET significantly inhibited HCC growth and induced apoptosis. It also promoted CD8(+) T cell activation, proliferation and cytotoxicity, and enhanced their ability to secrete IFN-gamma and TNF-alpha. TET also induced DNA damage and dsDNA accumulation, and activated STING/TBK1/IRF3 signal. STING knockdown experiments confirmed that this pathway was central for TET anti-cancer effects. In addition, TET and anti-PD-1 produced a significant synergistic anti-tumor effect, effectively inhibited HCC growth, increased CD8(+) T cell infiltration, and significantly improved liver and kidney function indicators. No obvious toxic reaction was observed. DISCUSSION: By activating STING/TBK1/IRF3 signaling, TET enhanced CD8(+) T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity, thereby markedly enhancing anti-PD-1 therapy efficacy in HCC.
abstract_zh: 引言：肝细胞癌（HCC）仍是全球重大公共卫生风险，其死亡率居高不下。粉防己碱（TET）可抑制肿瘤生长，但其与抗PD-1免疫治疗联合应用的效果尚未完全阐明。方法：在HCC细胞中敲低STING，并从外周血中提取和激活CD8(+) T细胞。将CD8(+) T细胞与HCC细胞共培养，并加入TET。本研究评估了TET在共培养体系中对HCC恶性行为和CD8(+) T细胞激活的影响。通过免疫荧光和Western blot检测gamma-H2AX和dsDNA。通过分子对接预测TET与STING/TBK1/IRF3通路蛋白的相互作用，并通过Western blot分析该通路的激活情况。在小鼠中建立皮下和原位HCC模型。通过肿瘤体积测量、组织病理学分析和免疫组化评估TET+抗PD-1的治疗效果，并检测血清生化指标以进行安全性评价。结果：TET显著抑制HCC生长并诱导凋亡。它还促进CD8(+) T细胞激活、增殖和细胞毒性，并增强其分泌IFN-gamma和TNF-alpha的能力。TET还诱导DNA损伤和dsDNA积累，并激活STING/TBK1/IRF3信号。STING敲低实验证实该通路是TET抗癌作用的核心。此外，TET和抗PD-1产生显著的协同抗肿瘤效应，有效抑制HCC生长，增加CD8(+) T细胞浸润，并显著改善肝肾功能指标。未观察到明显毒性反应。讨论：通过激活STING/TBK1/IRF3信号，TET增强了CD8(+) T细胞介导的抗肿瘤免疫，从而显著提高抗PD-1疗法在HCC中的疗效。
